fileSearch.title: File Search
fileSearch.subtitle: Let AI search inside the documents of a folder: PDF, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook
fileSearch.adminOnly: Only workspace administrators can set up File Search connectors.

worker.down: File Search is not running on this server.
worker.downHint: The files worker or the text extractor is not reachable. An administrator starts them with the Compose profile "files" (see the File Search docs).

source.cloudNote: AnythingMCP Cloud reaches servers on the internet. For a share in your office network use SFTP or WebDAV on the NAS, or run AnythingMCP self-hosted next to it.
source.name: Name
source.nameHint: Shown to the AI and in tool names, so name the content, not the server.
source.webdavHint: Nextcloud: Files → Settings → WebDAV shows the address. Synology: install WebDAV Server and use HTTPS (port 5006).
source.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved password
source.appPasswordHint: Nextcloud and ownCloud: create an app password under Security → Devices & sessions.
source.noLocalRoots: No folder is allowed yet. An administrator sets FILE_SOURCE_ROOTS to the mounted folders AnythingMCP may read.
source.folderHint: Everything below this folder is included. You choose subfolders after the scan.
source.plainFtpWarning: Plain FTP sends the password unencrypted over the internet. I understand and accept this (better: use FTPS or SFTP).

sftp.title: SFTP
sftp.description: SSH file transfer. Most NAS and Linux servers, Hetzner Storage Box.

ftp.title: FTP / FTPS
ftp.description: FTP with TLS (explicit or implicit), e.g. Fritz!Box, web hosting.

webdav.title: WebDAV / Nextcloud
webdav.description: Nextcloud, ownCloud, Synology and QNAP WebDAV.

local.title: Network folder
local.description: A share or volume mounted into this self-hosted install (SMB, NFS).

s3.title: S3 bucket
s3.description: AWS S3, DigitalOcean Spaces, MinIO, Hetzner, Wasabi.

test.intro: AnythingMCP connects to the server, signs in and lists the folder. Nothing is saved until the test passes.

fingerprint.title: Confirm the server's identity
fingerprint.ssh: This is the fingerprint of the server's SSH host key. Compare it with the one your administrator or the NAS shows. Once confirmed, AnythingMCP refuses to connect if it ever changes, which protects you from a server pretending to be yours.
fingerprint.tls: The server uses a certificate no public authority vouches for, which is normal for a NAS or router. Compare its fingerprint with the one the device shows; once confirmed, only this certificate is accepted.
fingerprint.confirmLabel: I checked this fingerprint and it belongs to our server.

scan.intro: The scan lists the whole folder without indexing anything: how many files are in each subfolder, which types and years. It also reads a few small sample documents to describe the content. Then you choose what to include.
scan.aiConsent: Folder names, file names and the first 2,000 characters of up to 20 sample files are sent to {provider}. Personal data in the samples is masked.
scan.aiPolicyOff: AI drafting is switched off by your workspace policy; the description is built from the folder structure.
scan.aiUnavailable: No AI model is configured on this server; the description is built from the folder structure.
scan.truncated: The folder is very large: the scan stopped counting. Choose a subfolder in step 1 for an exact count.
scan.typesHint: No type selected = every type. Other files are still found by name.

describe.intro: This text tells the AI what the folder contains and how to search it. Every MCP server with this connector passes it on. Check it and add what only you know.
describe.byAi: Written by AI ({model}). Check it before saving.
describe.byRules: Built from the folder structure and the sample documents.
describe.summaryHint: Appears in every tool description. {n} characters left.
describe.instructionsHint: What the documents are, how folders are named, what to watch out for.
describe.terms: Frequent terms (click to add to the summary)
describe.previewText: Search the text of every document in the folder "{name}" ({summary})…

activate.intervalHint: New and changed files are picked up on every sync. Search keeps working while a sync runs.
activate.noServers: There is no MCP server yet. You can add the connector to one later.
activate.serversHint: Only roles that have these tools can use them.
activate.summary: {files} files ({size}) will be indexed, then synced {interval}.
activate.cta: Activate and start the first sync
activate.ocrHint: Scanned PDFs without a text layer are read with text recognition. Slower; available with Enterprise.

budget.others: + {n} in your other File Search connectors
budget.overWithNext: The selection is larger than your plan. Untick folders or file types, or upgrade: the {plan} plan includes {max} files.
budget.over: The selection is larger than your plan. Untick folders or file types.

locked.title: File Search is part of the paid editions
locked.point1: Search inside PDF, Excel, Word and Outlook files from Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot and other AI clients.
locked.point2: SFTP, FTP/FTPS, WebDAV and network folders, synced in the background.
locked.point3: Temporary download links, permissions per role, audit log.

card.title: File Search
card.description: Search inside the documents of a folder: SFTP, FTP, WebDAV, NAS or a network share.

shareConnector.title: File Share
shareConnector.text: Lets AI clients publish files they create as temporary download links. Links, limits and the workspace policy are managed in Settings.

panel.draftText: This connector was tested but not activated yet: it has no tools and does not sync.

paused.paused_quota: Sync paused: the folder outgrew your plan
paused.paused_licence: Sync paused: File Search needs a licence
paused.paused_error: Sync paused: the server could not be reached
paused.stillSearching: The AI still searches the files indexed until {date}.

panel.resumed: Resumed. The next sync starts within a minute.
panel.planUsage: {used} of {max} files on the {plan} plan (all File Search connectors)
panel.description: What the AI is told about this folder
panel.newDraft: The last scan wrote a new description.
panel.descriptionSaved: Description saved; the tools were updated.
panel.runCounters: {listed} files listed, {added} new or changed, {extracted} read, {deleted} removed
panel.problemsHint: They are still found by name. Files that fail three times are retried only when they change.

rules.title: Folder permissions
rules.intro: Limit roles to some folders of this connector. A role without rules sees everything; with rules it sees only the allowed folders, and deny wins.
rules.enterprise: Folder permissions by role are available with AnythingMCP Enterprise. Until then, connect each folder as its own connector and give it to the right roles.

limit.title: Your plan’s File Search connectors are in use
limit.text: The {plan} plan includes {max} File Search connector(s), and all are set up. Upgrade, or delete one you no longer need.

fileShare.title: File Share
fileShare.subtitle: Temporary download links for files from your folders or written by AI. Links expire on their own and the file is deleted.

locked.title: File Share is not part of this plan
locked.text: Upgrade to let AI clients hand out files as temporary links.

usage.title: Your limits ({plan})
usage.publicOff: Public links are switched off; links open only for signed-in members.

connector.title: Links from AI chats
connector.on: The connector "{name}" lets AI clients publish files they write (CSV, reports) as links.
connector.off: Add the File Share connector so AI clients can publish files they write (CSV, reports) as links.
connector.added: File Share connector added to your default MCP server.

links.title: Links
links.count: {n, plural, one {# active link} other {# active links}}
links.confirm: Revoke this link and delete the file?

policy.title: File Search and File Share policy
policy.intro: Applies to every File Search connector and link in this workspace.
policy.enterprise: Workspace policies are available with AnythingMCP Enterprise.

publicLinks.label: Allow public links
publicLinks.hint: Off: links open only for signed-in members of this workspace.

aiDrafting.label: Allow AI to draft folder descriptions
aiDrafting.hint: Off: the setup never sends folder names or samples to an AI model.

allowPlainFtp.label: Allow plain (unencrypted) FTP
allowPlainFtp.hint: Off: only SFTP and FTPS can be connected.

policy.locked: With AnythingMCP Enterprise an administrator can switch off public links, AI drafting and plain FTP, and cap how long links stay valid.

state.exhausted: This link reached its download limit.

link.warning: Only open files from people you trust. AnythingMCP does not check files for viruses.
